issues.detail: The Greek 'εισ αρτος εν σωμα' describes the state of being 'one bread in one body' (or 'one bread in a body'). The Vietnamese translation 'chỉ có một ổ bánh, chúng ta là nhiều người, cũng chỉ một thân thể' shifts the structure to 'there is only one loaf, we are many people, also only one body,' which creates a list of separate entities rather than the Greek construction of being 'one bread in [a] body'.
